entities.title: Presentation
entities.summary: Everything the pilot sees and presses: the bridge crate and the Godot scenes and scripts.
entities.purpose: Groups the outermost layer: bridge/ (lodestar-bridge, the Rust classes GDScript calls), game/ (the main scene and its keys), space/ (the 3D picture and camera), ships/ (the ship rig), hud/, ui/ (the panels) and text/ (every word).
boundaries: Scenes reach the sim only through SimHost; they read snapshots and events and never write the sim's state.
